description: Build professional, client-ready Excel reports with openpyxl — header styling, borders, number formats instead of a bare data dump — and pull data from large or messy .xlsm files (investment-banking models, files resaved by non-Excel tools) via zipfile+XML parsing when openpyxl errors or silently returns incomplete data. Use when the user asks for a \"polished\", \"professional\", or \"client-ready\" spreadsheet; wants formatting applied to spreadsheet output instead of raw values; mentions a large or complex .xlsm/.xlsx that openpyxl won't open, is slow, or reads back wrong; or wants to control the Excel window on a Mac — scroll to a cell, zoom, select a range — via AppleScript without it hanging if Excel isn't responding. The window-control piece is macOS-only (drives real Microsoft Excel.app via osascript); it is not cross-platform automation. Use even without those words — \"make this spreadsheet look professional\", \"this xlsm won't extract right\", \"jump to Z100 and zoom in on my Mac\".
